page_topic_one_liner: Ambient AI medical scribes — encounter audio to SOAP notes, EHR write-back, ICD-10/CPT coding, and enterprise vs solo-practice tiers
differentiator_vs_generic: This is HIPAA clinical documentation automation, NOT generic meeting note-takers. Hero must show encounter audio waveform → structured SOAP note card (S/O/A/P sections) with EHR write-back arrow — NOT Zoom summary bullets or generic transcription UI.
visual_anchors: HERO (~55% canvas): Clinical documentation pipeline — left: ambient audio waveform with physician/patient speaker diarization color bands; right: structured SOAP note card with four labeled sections (Subjective, Objective, Assessment, Plan) as blurred text blocks, accent border on Assessment section
Secondary: EHR write-back arrow from SOAP card into generic EHR chart panel shape (no Epic/Nuance logos)
Tertiary: ICD-10 and CPT code suggestion chips floating below SOAP card
anti_patterns: Zoom/meeting note-taker UI (page is clinical not corporate)
Generic microphone icon without SOAP structure
Real EHR vendor logos (Epic, Nuance, Abridge)
Patient faces or identifiable PHI imagery
